up: Retrieve up to 1000 activity rows for the human target CHEMBL2157854 (Ubiquitin carboxyl-terminal hydrolase 8). For each row, return the assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Filter for activities where the standard relation is exactly '=' and the pChEMBL value is not null. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and then by assay ChEMBL ID. Limit the output to 1000 rows.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  a.assay_chembl_id,
  tt.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2157854'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  a.molecule_chembl_id,
  a.assay_chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
